entities.name: Skrikkle
entities.description: A goblin who sets out alone into the danger-danger land to hunt grubs with his maulhorn-tooth digging stick and dreams of becoming king.

entities.name: Groggle
entities.description: A goblin of Skrikkle's warren who fights over skrill scraps.

entities.name: Grooble
entities.description: A crook-legged goblin with a rusty knife whom Skrikkle dislikes and suspects of dangerous ideas.

entities.name: Snurkle
entities.description: Skrikkle's great-grandfather who brought back a maulhorn tooth and tied it to a stick for grub hunting.

entities.name: Maulhorn
entities.description: A beast whose tooth Snurkle pulled from its jaw.

entities.name: Danger-danger land
entities.description: Dangerous wilds outside the goblin warren where grubs and tuskers are found.

entities.name: Wurms
entities.description: Creatures that violently defend their grubs.

events.summary: Skrikkle, tired of skrill slime, throws it at Groggle and storms out of the warren to hunt grubs.
events.quote: He slung his dried slime at Groggle and tromped out of the warren in a huff.

events.summary: Flashback: Snurkle returns bloodied from the danger-danger land with a maulhorn tooth.
events.quote: Snurkle muttered something about pulling it from a maulhorn's jaw

events.summary: Flashback: Snurkle ties the tooth to a hickory stick and sets off to hunt grubs.
events.quote: A gasp went through the warren as Snurkle took the tooth and tied it to his own great-grandpap's hickory stick

events.summary: Skrikkle plots to become king and kill Grooble with his stick.
events.quote: Then he would shove his maulhorn-toothed digging stick into Grooble's guts.

events.summary: Skrikkle duels an imaginary Grooble and fails to notice an approaching giant foot.
events.quote: So good that he didn't notice the rumbling sensation from the earth
There was a thunderous impact, and with it faded the echoes and vain hopes born of madness.

relations.note: Dislikes and plans to kill him.
relations.quote: Skrikkle didn't like Grooble one bit.
